text: Got all three messages (the first two plus this one). I wasn't watching the chat when they arrived, sorry. I'm building them as one update now: monitor-first app layout (Engine and Claude as their own sections, phone-only features removed), clear messages (trash per message and Clear all), a thumbs-up when Claude has read a message, and screenshots/attachments in chat that auto-delete from GitHub after a day unless Claude flags them.
